title: Stylized low-poly mushroom (Python (trimesh + numpy))
seed: Build a script from scratch in Python (trimesh + numpy) that procedurally generates: Build a mushroom from a hemispherical (or flattened-dome) cap mesh seated atop a tapered cylindrical stem. Cap radius/flatness, stem height/radius, and mesh resolution must be CLI-configurable. Save to glb, obj with deterministic seeding, CLI parameterization, and an independent post-save validation step.
